info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Adopteds-v1-spec
info.description: The Adopted Pets Listing API provides a comprehensive overview of pets that have been successfully adopted through the platform. It enables users to retrieve detailed information about each adopted pet, including their profile, adoption date, and history. This API is beneficial for organizations tracking adoption statistics or for potential adopters looking for inspiration from successfully placed pets. Typical consumers include animal shelters, pet adoption platforms, and developers integrating pet adoption data into their applications.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of adopted pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to access information about pets that have been adopted. It returns a collection of adopted pets along with their details, helping potential pet owners to understand the options available.

requestBody.description: Request to fetch the list of adopted pets. This request body should contain any optional filters or parameters that might be necessary for retrieving the relevant information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of adopted pets.
